players.note: NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports that teams seeking help at wide receiver will likely call the Eagles about the status of Brown before the Nov. 10 deadline.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (quadriceps) was active but didn't play any snaps Sunday in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

players.name: Khalil Herbert
players.note: The Falcons elevated Herbert from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Allen caught both of his passes for 27 yards during the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

players.name: Cole Kmet
players.note: The Bears placed Kmet (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Velus Jones Jr.
players.note: Jones turned four carries into 20 yards and caught his only target for minus-1 yard during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos.

players.name: Kene Nwangwu
players.note: Nwangwu (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

players.name: David Sills V
players.note: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.note: Stowers (quadriceps), who is on injured reserve, is officially questionable to play Monday against Dallas.

players.name: Trevor Etienne
players.note: Etienne (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

players.name: Coleman Owen
players.note: The Packers signed Owen from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

players.name: DeAndre Carter
players.note: The Lions signed Carter to the active roster Thursday.

players.name: Brashard Smith
players.note: The Chiefs placed Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Isaiah Davis
players.note: Davis rushed seven times for 16 yards and caught his only target for 10 yards during Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.

players.name: Emari Demercado
players.note: Demercado (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday night's matchup with the Packers, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Claiborne carried the ball three times for 12 yards during Minnesota's win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

players.name: Tyler Badie
players.note: The Broncos placed Badie (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Beck (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Elijah Arroyo
players.note: Head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters Friday that Arroyo (shoulder) underwent surgery and will likely be out for the rest of the season, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.note: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Cardinals on Sunday.

players.name: Anthony Richardson Sr.
players.note: Richardson was charged with misdemeanor possession of marijuana in Carmel, Indiana earlier this week, Tyler Haughn of FOX 59 reports.

players.name: Jalon Daniels
players.note: Daniels is expected to work as Tampa Bay's No. 2 QB on Sunday in Carolina, as Baker Mayfield (thumb) is questionable to play but is expected to start, Scott Smith and Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site report.

players.name: Blake Grupe
players.note: Rams head coach Sean McVay announced Monday that Grupe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn ACL in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

players.name: Colbie Young
players.note: Young (knee) was not listed on the Bengals' injury report Wednesday.

players.name: Jaylin Lane
players.note: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Alec Ingold
players.note: The Chargers placed Ingold on injured reserve Thursday due to a shoulder injury.

players.name: Andy Dalton
players.note: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Wednesday that Dalton is in a "ramp-up period" and will be inactive for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Case Keenum
players.note: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will operate as the Bears' emergency third quarterback for Thursday night's matchup against the Patriots.

players.name: Grant Calcaterra
players.note: Calcaterra, who is on injured reserve due to a back injury, is questionable to suit up Monday versus Dallas.

players.name: Luke Musgrave
players.note: Packers head coach Matt Lafleur said Thursday it's "tough to say" whether Musgrave (neck) plays this season, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Aidan O'Connell
players.note: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Sunday.

players.name: Irv Charles
players.note: The Seahawks signed Charles off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Audric Estime
players.note: Estime turned nine carries into 19 yards and a touchdown during the Browns' 13-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

players.name: David Martin-Robinson
players.note: Martin-Robinson (hamstring) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.note: Wayne was claimed off waivers by the Dolphins on Tuesday.

players.name: Dillon Gabriel
players.note: Gabriel (back) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Titans, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
players.note: Thornton (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Beaux Collins
players.note: Collins (hip) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Carter Runyon
players.note: Runyon (foot) was a full participant in practice Wednesday.

players.name: Jackson Meeks
players.note: Meeks (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Arizona.

players.name: Justin Joly
players.note: Joly (concussion) did not appear on the Dolphins' injury report Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Behren Morton
players.note: Morton (coach's decision) is inactive and designated as New England's emergency third quarterback for Thursday's matchup versus Chicago.

players.name: Justin Watson
players.note: The Chiefs elevated Watson from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

players.name: Tanner Hudson
players.note: Hudson (pectoral) was placed on injured reserve by the Bengals on Monday.

players.name: Tom Kennedy
players.note: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: DeeJay Dallas
players.note: The Vikings signed Dallas to the practice squad and elevated him to the active roster Saturday.

players.name: K.J. Osborn
players.note: The Titans elevated Osborn from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Michael Carter
players.note: Carter (abdomen) has been ruled out to play the Cowboys on Monday Night Football in Week 7.

players.name: Brandon Johnson
players.note: The Steelers elevated Johnson from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

players.name: Jalin Hyatt
players.note: The Giants elevated Hyatt from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Cedric Tillman
players.note: The Saints elevated Tillman from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Evan Hull
players.note: The Cardinals signed Hull from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

players.name: Jaleel McLaughlin
players.note: McLaughlin's role in the offense could sharply decrease against the Titans on Sunday, as Quinshon Judkins (ankle) has been cleared to play and Dylan Sampson (knee) is expected to be activated off injured reserve, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
